# Citations

All sources visited in-session via WebSearch or WebFetch. Numbered sequentially.

## Academic Papers

[1] V. Salis, T. Sotiropoulos, P. Louridas, D. Spinellis, D. Mitropoulos.
"PyCG: Practical Call Graph Generation in Python." ICSE 2021.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.00587
**Data extracted:** Precision ~99.2%, recall ~69.9%, 112 micro-benchmark programs,
5 macro-benchmark packages, 0.38s per 1k LoC average, flow-insensitive analysis,
fails on programs >2,000 LoC in whole-program mode.

[2] (JARVIS authors). "Scalable and Precise Application-Centered Call Graph
Construction for Python." Submitted to TOSEM.
https://arxiv.org/html/2305.05949v3
**Data extracted:** 67% faster than PyCG, 84% higher precision, ≥20% higher recall,
135 micro-benchmark programs, 6 macro-benchmark apps (FastAPI, HTTPie, Scrapy,
Lightning, Airflow, Sherlock), 8.16s avg / 227 MB for application-centered CGC,
PyCG failed on 4/6 apps (24hr timeout), 1 recursion error, 1 OOM at 8GB.

[3] (Springer, 2025). "An empirical study of large language models for type
and call graph analysis in Python and JavaScript."
https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10664-025-10704-3
**Data extracted:** Static analysis tools (PyCG, Jelly) significantly outperform
LLMs in call-graph generation.

[4] (ACM TOSEM). "InferCG: Enhancing Python Call Graph Generation via Static
Analysis and LLM-based Semantic Reasoning."
https://dl.acm.org/doi/epdf/10.1145/3799990
**Data extracted:** Hybrid framework combining static analysis with LLM-based
semantic reasoning for improved Python call graph accuracy.

[5] R. Gopinath. "A Minimal Static Call Graph for Python Programs." 2022.
https://rahul.gopinath.org/post/2022/02/16/python-callgraph/
**Data extracted:** Without full type inference, accurate call graphs are
impossible. Higher-order functions make resolution "nearly impossible."
Complete call graph harder than complete control flow graph.

[6] Wikipedia. "Call graph."
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_graph
**Data extracted:** Exact static call graph is undecidable. Static algorithms
are overapproximations. Dynamic call graphs trace actual execution.

[7] (ACM, 1993). "Undecidability of Static Analysis."
https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/161494.161501
**Data extracted:** May-alias is undecidable, must-alias is uncomputable for
languages with conditionals, loops, and dynamic storage. Rice's theorem applies.

[8] LaToza, Myers. "Visualizing Call Graphs." CMU.
https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~NatProg/papers/Paper3_LaTozaAndMyers_paper.pdf
**Data extracted:** REACHER tool — developers 5x more successful at answering
reachability questions. Developers spend tens of minutes, get lost and disoriented
with existing visualizations.

[9] PyAnalyzer (ICSE 2024). "Python-Specific Call Graph Tools."
https://deepwiki.com/xjtu-enre/ICSE2024_PyAnalyzer/5.2-python-specific-call-graph-tools
**Data extracted:** Comparison of PyCG, Pyan, Depends for Python call graph
construction.

[10] (ScienceDirect, 2021). "Facilitating program comprehension with call graph
multilevel hierarchical abstractions."
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S016412122100042X
**Data extracted:** Call graphs assist understanding from high-level abstraction
to low-level implementation.

[11] (arXiv, 2024). "Cross-Ecosystem Vulnerability Analysis for Python
Applications."
https://arxiv.org/html/2603.18693
**Data extracted:** PyXSieve stitches Python and binary call graphs for
cross-language reachability analysis of CVEs.

[12] (ACM TOSEM). "ReachCheck: Compositional Library-Aware Call Graph
Reachability Analysis in IDEs."
https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3767166
**Data extracted:** Compositional reachability analysis approach.

[13] Gul et al. "Survey on Static Analysis Tools of Python Programs." 2019.
https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-2508/paper-gul.pdf
**Data extracted:** Undefined variable references only discovered at runtime.
Dynamic nature limits analyzer techniques.

## Security and Taint Analysis

[47] Meta Engineering. "Pysa: Open Source static analysis for Python code." 2020.
https://engineering.fb.com/2020/08/07/security/pysa/
**Data extracted:** Interprocedural taint analysis built on Pyre. Targets
Instagram's millions of LoC. Results in ~1 hour. H1 2020: detected 44% of
issues found by security engineers. 330 unique issues flagged, 49 significant,
150 false positives (45% FP rate). Cannot detect authorization flaws.
No decorator support in call graphs.

[48] Pysa basics documentation.
https://pyre-check.org/docs/pysa-basics/
**Data extracted:** Source/sink/sanitizer model. Built on Pyre type checker.
Function-level analysis only — top-level code invisible.

[49] Semgrep taint analysis overview.
https://semgrep.dev/docs/writing-rules/data-flow/taint-mode/overview
**Data extracted:** Intraprocedural (CE), interprocedural intra-file
(--pro-intrafile), cross-file (--pro). Taint summaries collected per function.
CE: all function calls opaque. Recommends 8 GB/core for inter-file analysis.

[50] Semgrep dataflow analysis overview.
https://semgrep.dev/docs/writing-rules/data-flow/data-flow-overview
**Data extracted:** Dataflow engine supports constant propagation and taint
tracking. Interprocedural analysis is Pro-only feature.

[51] Endor Labs. "Introducing Reachability-Based SCA for Python, Go, and C#."
https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/introducing-sca-reachability-analysis-for-python-go-and-c
**Data extracted:** Call graph-based reachability analysis for vulnerability
prioritization.

[52] Snyk. "Reachability analysis."
https://docs.snyk.io/manage-risk/prioritize-issues-for-fixing/reachability-analysis
**Data extracted:** Determines if vulnerable dependency functions are actually
reachable from application code.

[53] PyXray GitHub repository.
https://github.com/grgalex/pyxray
**Data extracted:** Cross-language (Python + native binary) call graph
construction. CVE reachability analysis across dependency boundaries.

[54] Raven.io. "Why Static Analysis Falls Short in Dynamic Programming Languages."

**Data extracted:** Reflection, dynamic imports, eval are "invisible" to
static analysis. Type hints optional and unenforced.

[55] Python typing documentation. "Reasons to avoid static type checking."
https://typing.python.org/en/latest/guides/typing_anti_pitch.html
**Data extracted:** Dynamic frameworks make type checking "unlikely to help."
Requires redesign or clever annotations.

[56] dev.to. "Dead Code in Python Is Undecidable."
https://dev.to/sendotltd/dead-code-in-python-is-undecidable-so-i-built-a-detector-that-admits-it-1k8j
**Data extracted:** getattr, duck typing, import-by-string, metaclasses make
call graphs impossible. Confidence tiers as practical solution.

[57] CERFACS. "Generating and using a Callgraph, in Python."

**Data extracted:** Python 3.12 tracing 7x slower vs baseline (50s vs 6.4s),
